verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמֹ֥ור לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ
verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־אֵבֹ֣ושָׁה לְעֹולָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: عَلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ تَوَكَّلْتُ. لَا تَدَعْنِي أَخْزَى مَدَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. بِعَدْلِكَ نَجِّنِي.
verses.en: In thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; let me never be ashamed; deliver me in Thy righteousness.
verses.kjv: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

verses.he: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י ׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י ׀ לְֽצוּר־מָ֭עֹוז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּדֹ֗ות לְהֹושִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: أَمِلْ إِلَيَّ أُذُنَكَ. سَرِيعًا أَنْقِذْنِي. كُنْ لِي صَخْرَةَ حِصْنٍ، بَيْتَ مَلْجَإٍ لِتَخْلِيصِي.
verses.en: Incline Thine ear unto me, deliver me speedily; be Thou to me a rock of refuge, even a fortress of defence, to save me.
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.web: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

verses.he: כִּֽי־סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ صَخْرَتِي وَمَعْقِلِي أَنْتَ. مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱسْمِكَ تَهْدِينِي وَتَقُودُنِي.
verses.en: For Thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for Thy name's sake lead me and guide me.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.web: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

verses.he: תֹּוצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃
verses.ar: أَخْرِجْنِي مِنَ ٱلشَّبَكَةِ ٱلَّتِي خَبَّأُوهَا لِي، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ حِصْنِي.
verses.en: Bring me forth out of the net that they have hidden for me; for Thou art my stronghold.
verses.kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou [art] my strength.
verses.web: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

verses.he: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אֹותִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.ar: فِي يَدِكَ أَسْتَوْدِعُ رُوحِي. فَدَيْتَنِي يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.en: Into Thy hand I commit my spirit; Thou hast redeemed me, O LORD, Thou God of truth.
verses.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
verses.web: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

verses.he: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.ar: أَبْغَضْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرَاعُونَ أَبَاطِيلَ كَاذِبَةً. أَمَّا أَنَا فَعَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ تَوَكَّلْتُ.
verses.en: I hate them that regard lying vanities; but I trust in the LORD.
verses.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
verses.web: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

verses.he: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָרֹ֥ות נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.ar: أَبْتَهِجُ وَأَفْرَحُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، لِأَنَّكَ نَظَرْتَ إِلَى مَذَلَّتِي، وَعَرَفْتَ فِي ٱلشَّدَائِدِ نَفْسِي،
verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy lovingkindness; for Thou hast seen mine affliction, Thou hast taken cognizance of the troubles of my soul,
verses.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.web: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

verses.he: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אֹויֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.ar: وَلَمْ تَحْبِسْنِي فِي يَدِ ٱلْعَدُوِّ، بَلْ أَقَمْتَ فِي ٱلرُّحْبِ رِجْلِي.
verses.en: And Thou hast not given me over into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a broad place.
verses.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.web: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

verses.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃
verses.ar: اِرْحَمْنِي يَارَبُّ لِأَنِّي فِي ضِيْقٍ. خَسَفَتْ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ عَيْنِي. نَفْسِي وَبَطْنِي.
verses.en: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, for I am in distress; mine eye wasteth away with vexation, yea, my soul and my body.
verses.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, [yea], my soul and my belly.
verses.web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

verses.he: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָגֹ֡ון חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנֹותַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֹנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ حَيَاتِي قَدْ فَنِيَتْ بِٱلْحُزْنِ، وَسِنِينِي بِٱلتَّنَهُّدِ. ضَعُفَتْ بِشَقَاوَتِي قُوَّتِي، وَبَلِيَتْ عِظَامِي.
verses.en: For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in sighing; my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted away.
verses.kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.web: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

verses.he: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י ׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.ar: عِنْدَ كُلِّ أَعْدَائِي صِرْتُ عَارًا، وَعِنْدَ جِيرَانِي بِٱلْكُلِّيَّةِ، وَرُعْبًا لِمَعَارِفِي. ٱلَّذِينَ رَأَوْنِي خَارِجًا هَرَبُوا عَنِّي.
verses.en: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, yea, unto my neighbours exceedingly, and a dread to mine acquaintance; they that see me without flee from me.
verses.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.web: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

verses.he: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.ar: نُسِيتُ مِنَ ٱلْقَلْبِ مِثْلَ ٱلْمَيْتِ. صِرْتُ مِثْلَ إِنَاءٍ مُتْلَفٍ.
verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind; I am like a useless vessel.
verses.kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.web: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

verses.he: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי ׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָגֹ֪ור מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنِّي سَمِعْتُ مَذَمَّةً مِنْ كَثِيرِينَ. ٱلْخَوْفُ مُسْتَدِيرٌ بِي بِمُؤَامَرَتِهِمْ مَعًا عَلَيَّ. تَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَخْذِ نَفْسِي.
verses.en: For I have heard the whispering of many, terror on every side; while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: fear [was] on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.web: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ يَارَبُّ. قُلْتُ: «إِلَهِي أَنْتَ».
verses.en: But as for me, I have trusted in Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my God.'
verses.kjv: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my God.
verses.web: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

verses.he: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־אֹ֝ויְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃
verses.ar: فِي يَدِكَ آجَالِي. نَجِّنِي مِنْ يَدِ أَعْدَائِي وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَطْرُدُونَنِي.
verses.en: My times are in Thy hand; deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.kjv: My times [are] in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.web: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

verses.he: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ הֹ֖ושִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَضِئْ بِوَجْهِكَ عَلَى عَبْدِكَ. خَلِّصْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ.
verses.en: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; save me in Thy lovingkindness.
verses.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.web: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־אֵ֭בֹושָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֹֽול׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، لَا تَدَعْنِي أَخْزَى لِأَنِّي دَعَوْتُكَ. لِيَخْزَ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ. لِيَسْكُتُوا فِي ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ.
verses.en: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon Thee; let the wicked be ashamed, let them be put to silence in the nether-world.
verses.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, [and] let them be silent in the grave.
verses.web: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

verses.he: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְרֹ֖ות עַל־צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃
verses.ar: لِتُبْكَمْ شِفَاهُ ٱلْكَذِبِ، ٱلْمُتَكَلِّمَةُ عَلَى ٱلصِّدِّيقِ بِوَقَاحَةٍ، بِكِبْرِيَاءَ وَٱسْتِهَانَةٍ.
verses.en: Let the lying lips be dumb, which speak arrogantly against the righteous, with pride and contempt.
verses.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.web: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

verses.he: מָ֤ה רַֽב־טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃
verses.ar: مَا أَعْظَمَ جُودَكَ ٱلَّذِي ذَخَرْتَهُ لِخَائِفِيكَ، وَفَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُتَّكِلِينَ عَلَيْكَ تُجَاهَ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ!
verses.en: Oh how abundant is Thy goodness, which Thou hast laid up for them that fear Thee; which Thou hast wrought for them that take their refuge in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men!
verses.kjv: [Oh] how great [is] thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.web: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

verses.he: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם ׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֹֽות׃
verses.ar: تَسْتُرُهُمْ بِسِتْرِ وَجْهِكَ مِنْ مَكَايِدِ ٱلنَّاسِ. تُخْفِيهِمْ فِي مَظَلَّةٍ مِنْ مُخَاصَمَةِ ٱلْأَلْسُنِ
verses.en: Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plottings of man; Thou concealest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.web: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

verses.he: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדֹּ֥ו לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֹֽור׃
verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ، لِأَنَّهُ قَدْ جَعَلَ عَجَبًا رَحْمَتَهُ لِي فِي مَدِينَةٍ مُحَصَّنَةٍ.
verses.en: Blessed be the LORD; for He hath shown me His wondrous lovingkindness in an entrenched city.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.web: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ קֹ֥ול תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: وَأَنَا قُلْتُ فِي حَيْرَتِي: «إِنِّي قَدِ ٱنْقَطَعْتُ مِنْ قُدَّامِ عَيْنَيْكَ». وَلَكِنَّكَ سَمِعْتَ صَوْتَ تَضَرُّعِي إِذْ صَرَخْتُ إِلَيْكَ.
verses.en: As for me, I said in my haste: 'I am cut off from before Thine eyes'; nevertheless Thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto Thee.
verses.kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.web: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

verses.he: אֽ͏ֶהֱב֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃
verses.ar: أَحِبُّوا ٱلرَّبَّ يَا جَمِيعَ أَتْقِيَائِهِ. ٱلرَّبُّ حَافِظُ ٱلْأَمَانَةِ، وَمُجَازٍ بِكِثْرَةٍ ٱلْعَامِلَ بِٱلْكِبْرِيَاءِ.
verses.en: O love the LORD, all ye His godly ones; the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully repayeth him that acteth haughtily.
verses.kjv: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: [for] the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.web: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

verses.he: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: لِتَتَشَدَّدْ وَلْتَتَشَجَّعْ قُلُوبُكُمْ، يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلْمُنْتَظِرِينَ ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.en: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all ye that wait for the LORD.
verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
